01 / THE IDEA☼

Your phone knows
your steps.
But how are you?

The hours you slept. The distance you walked. The workout you finished. The numbers tell part of the story.

Intend makes room for the rest. What lifted you. What took more than you expected. The small things that made a day feel good.

A few honest moments.
A clearer picture of yourself.

A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT WONDER

Before you begin.

What can I try right now?+

You can choose a few habits, complete morning and evening reflections, log glasses of water, and explore illustrative pattern and recipe screens. It is a working web preview, with no account or permanent storage. Reloading or leaving the app clears your entries.

Will Intend be available on my phone?+

This web preview works on phones, tablets, and computers. Dedicated iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. A release date has not been announced.

Does it connect to my health data or journal yet?+

Not yet. Sleep, steps, workout connections, photo scanning, and real personal insights are part of the product vision. This preview does not request access to any of those sources.

Is this a wellness program or medical advice?+

Intend is a place for self-reflection, not a medical service or treatment plan. Future insights are intended to show associations in your reflections, not diagnose conditions or establish causes.

Do I need to sign up?+

No. Mock version 1 is free to explore without a login. Please use sample information when trying it. Account creation and saved history will be introduced separately.

THERE’S NO PERFECT PLACE TO START.
